# Open Coworker

> A macOS home for persistent AI coworkers built on the OpenWork platform. Each coworker has a name, a role, memory kept as plain Markdown files, and a native OpenWork workspace. Local-first; OpenWork Cloud adds always-on responsibilities.

Open Coworker is early access and runs from source today (no packaged download yet). It is a second client on the OpenWork platform, not a second platform: the same embedded openwork-server, the managed OpenCode engine, native sessions through @openwork/headless-threads, and OpenWork Automations for cloud responsibilities.

## Setup

- [Start guide for agents](/start.md): prerequisites, run from source, first coworker, one assignment, on-disk verification.
- [Repository](https://github.com/different-ai/openwork): the OpenWork monorepo; Open Coworker lives in `apps/coworker`.

## Product facts

- Coworker homes are plain files under `~/.config/openwork/coworkers/<slug>/`: `soul.md`, `memory/working.md`, `memory/index.md`, `memory/long-term/*.md`, `workspace/`, `coworker.md`.
- Assignments are native OpenWork threads. Permission and question requests from the engine appear inside the thread and wait for a person.
- Responsibilities run in one of two places: This Mac (while the app is open; one missed run recovered on launch) or OpenWork Cloud (even when the Mac is off; organization models; no access to local files).
- Retiring a coworker archives its folder; nothing is deleted until a separate permanent-delete action.

## OpenWork

- [OpenWork](https://openworklabs.com): the open-source platform underneath.
- [OpenWork Cloud sign-up](https://app.openworklabs.com?mode=sign-up): free for up to 5 users; Team and Enterprise plans at https://openworklabs.com/pricing.
